backtest.execution: next_open — orders decided on session D's close fill at D+1's open
backtest.risk_rationale: measure the strategies' own behaviour; operational breakers (drawdown halt, daily loss, vol target) are switched off so they cannot mask or create an edge
backtest.slippage_model: half-spread + square-root impact (impact_coef * daily vol * sqrt(order/ADV notional))

classification.EVIDENCE_SUPPORTS_FURTHER_RESEARCH: all gates pass on development AND the holdout passes AND the strategy is not fragile at 2x costs
classification.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: a required statistic lacks sample, or development Sharpe > 0 but any gate fails
classification.REJECT: development net Sharpe <= 0, or the locked holdout fails its criterion
classification.note: criteria fixed here; they are not changed after results

cost_stress.fragile_if: Sharpe at 2x costs <= 0, or below half of the baseline Sharpe
cost_stress.window: development only (the holdout is not re-run)

data.benchmark: SPY total return (dividends reinvested) — the portfolio is credited dividends
data.corporate_actions: Tiingo splitFactor (incl. GE spin-offs encoded as factors) and divCash
data.prices: Tiingo daily OHLCV (split-adjusted, restated per as-of view), local cache, offline
data.risk_free_rate: 0 (no rate series in the cache); Sharpe is excess over zero
data.universe: runs/buffett-baseline/universe_top10.json — survivorship-aware PIT top-10 by market cap, annual reconstitution 2016-07-01..2025-07-01; membership = latest snapshot on or before the session
data.warmup_note: bars before 2016-07-01 are history only; no instrument is a member before the first snapshot

ensemble: only if at least two strategies are EVIDENCE_SUPPORTS_FURTHER_RESEARCH; evidence from development only

periods.holdout_rule: evaluated exactly once per strategy via LockedHoldout; fresh capital at holdout start; no change to any config after a holdout result

rebalance_rationale: momentum signals use 252-day lookbacks (monthly); mean reversion (20-day) and breakout (55-day channel) are short-horizon (weekly). Fixed before any result was seen.

small_account.currency_note: EUR 200 modelled as 200 USD-equivalent units; FX not modelled
variants: raw: every order the strategy produces
economics_filtered: drop orders whose expected edge (development round-trip expectancy in bp from the 100k development run, never the holdout) does not clear round-trip cost + 20bp

title: Phase A: out-of-sample evidence for four frozen reference strategies on real PIT data

validation.dsr: n_trials = distinct configs in the registry family; SR variance across those trials

pbo.configs: the four strategies' daily development returns

validation.walk_forward: frozen configs (nothing is fitted): consecutive calendar-year test windows 2017..2022 on the development backtest; statistic = share of windows with positive net Sharpe
